Profile.Name: Deep Space Tracking
Profile.Effect: When this Space Station targets enemy ships, Spikes on those ships have double their normal effect. So a Spike would increase the target's Signature by 6" instead of 3".

Profile.Name: Scanner Uplink
Profile.Effect: This Space Station's Scan range is increased by 3". In addition, friendly ships within 3" of one or more Space Stations with this special rule increase their Scan range by 3". This special rule ceases to function while this Space Station is controlled by an enemy player.

Profile.Name: Defensive Garrison
Profile.Effect: This Structure does not cost points and can only be taken by a player that is the Defender in a scenario, choosing the scenario and agreeing with your opponent ahead of time. This Space Station starts the game with 2/3/4 Battalions on it for Small/Medium/Large Space Stations respectively. A Space Station that takes a Defensive Garrison cannot take any other Structures.

Profile.Name: Forward Operating Base
Profile.Effect: This Feature does not cost points and can only be taken by a player that is the Attacker in a scenario, choosing the scenario and agreeing with your opponent ahead of time. This Space Station may launch a single Bomber each round in addition to its normal launch (following Launch timing, restrictions, and your faction's Bombers rules). Instead of attacking normally, you may remove this Bomber to place 2 Battalions on a Ship or Space Station in base contact with it. A Space Station that takes a Forward Operating Base cannot take any other Structures.
